M21 — 2026-09-23
Scratch scripts must never `rm -rf` a computed path unquoted or unguarded. zsh does not word-split `$var` (so `set -- $pair` keeps one argument), while a bash script it calls does split an unquoted `$F`. A two-path string then deletes both paths. On 2026-09-23 that deleted the /Users/jins/IO/sofar-rust-core worktree (rust-core 4.4 incident note). Quote every path and refuse anything outside the scratchpad before deleting, e.g. `case "$F" in "$SCRATCH"/*) rm -rf -- "$F";; *) exit 1;; esac`. Prefer a Node or Python driver over shell for multi-path harnesses.
